info.name: KHR_CAMERA_SHUTTER
info.comment: Local copy of the ANARI registry extension. The registry file attaches the parameter to an ANARI_CAMERA named 'default', which the query codegen would append as a bogus 'default' camera subtype; instead it is declared here on the camera subtypes this device actually exposes. Keep info.name equal to the official extension name so introspection still advertises it.
